blocks.text: Solve the two complete cost expressions
Break-even satisfies qn ≈ n log n + q log n. Move the query term to the left: q(n - log n) ≈ n log n, so q ≈ n log n / (n - log n).

For large n, n - log n = Θ(n), so q = Θ(log n). Θ(1) cannot generally repay sorting, while Θ(n) and Θ(n log n) are sufficient but not the threshold order. Exact crossover still depends on constants and existing order. Reusable rule: isolate the workload parameter algebraically, then simplify numerator and denominator asymptotically.

feedback.reason: Equating qn with n log n + q log n gives q approximately n log n divided by n - log n, which is Θ(log n).
